replies.author: Zedther
replies.body:
Hey there, Shadow.
I'm incredibly sorry for the wait.
Thanks for your patience.
The evidence for your ban can be found below.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kOwspcfj1O4
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ilo6jhzmC-4
It not may seem like much, but it's more than enough to sufficiently prove your use of triggerbot.

As you can clearly see, you are automatically clicking whenever there is any entity in front of you. 
If you have any further comments or any form of rebuttal, you're more than welcome to proceed.

Thanks.

replies.author: Zedther
replies.body:
It is to my understanding that you can have FOV on triggerbot, which
allows you to hit entities even when they are not directly in front of you.
In addition, how do you explain you punching in the first place?
You said nothing about you just randomly punching me for a laugh or something,
so why wouldn't it come to mind? 

P.s The rude comments aren't really appreciated, but if you have any rebuttal, 
you're more than welcome to proceed. 

Thanks
-Zedther
